scope: Offline retrospective research: do OHLCV-derived price/volume flow PROXIES add cross-sectional information about future XU100-relative returns BEYOND the existing Technical score? Not a trading P&L claim, not a prospective validation, not a production FlowScore.
terminology_rule: CMF/NSV/MFI are PRICE/VOLUME FLOW PROXIES. They must never be described as actual net money inflow/outflow.
primary_question: After controlling for the existing Technical score, does the candidate price/volume flow score (PVFS) carry positive cross-sectional rank information about 10-session forward XU100-relative return?

technical_blinding.reason: technical_v1_protocol_v1.json sets performance_visibility_before_first_checkpoint=false. User decision (FLOW 1B): Technical is used only as a statistical CONTROL. No Technical-only performance figure (Technical IC, Technical bucket mean/median return, Technical hit rate, Technical quintile returns) is computed, printed or persisted.
permitted_outputs: Flow feature ICs and quintile returns
Differences BETWEEN Flow groups INSIDE a Technical bucket (deltas only, never the bucket's own level)
Feature-feature correlations (including Technical score vs Flow features; these are not performance figures)

universe.no_replacement_rule: The frozen list is used as-is; it is never replaced by a freshly fetched BIST100 list and no symbol is removed because of observed results.
universe.survivorship_bias: HIGH RISK. Membership is fixed at 2026-09-09 and applied backwards. Results are NOT a historical BIST100-membership backtest.

data.provider: BistProvider (Yahoo Finance via yfinance), explicit start/end mode
data.adjustment_mode: yfinance Ticker.history default (auto_adjust=True): OHLC split- and dividend back-adjusted, Volume split-adjusted. Yahoo records BIST bonus issues (bedelsiz) as splits.
data.adjustment_limitation: Yahoo history can be retroactively re-adjusted. The study freezes one snapshot so the study itself cannot drift, but the snapshot is NOT proof of point-in-time prices. Rights issues (bedelli) handling is unverified.
data.requested_start_reason: Earliest date covered by the project's authoritative BIST trading calendar (trading_calendar.EARLIEST_SUPPORTED_CALENDAR_DATE). Earlier bars cannot be continuity-checked, so they are not used.
data.requested_end: latest_expected_completed_date() at freeze time (recorded in the dataset manifest)
data.fetch_once_rule: Data is fetched exactly once and frozen (gzip JSON + per-symbol content_sha256). The analysis step never contacts Yahoo and verifies every hash before use.

steps: normalize_bist_daily_sessions (authoritative calendar; drops weekend/holiday/cancelled phantom rows; counted)
per-row raw integrity (same rules as data_quality.check_raw_ohlcv_integrity): NaN/inf, non-positive price, negative volume, impossible OHLC -> row marked invalid (counted)

continuity: every expected session between a symbol's first and last valid bar must be present; a missing or invalid session splits the series into separate contiguous segments (counted). Nothing is forward/back-filled or fabricated.
preprocessing.segment_rule: All indicators, the Technical score and forward returns are computed within one contiguous segment only. No window may span a gap.
preprocessing.warmup_reason: Matches completed_history.INDICATOR_WARMUP_SESSIONS used by the project's backtest. The first 60 sessions of every segment are never an observation date T.
preprocessing.zero_volume_expected_sessions: Kept as genuine sessions (calendar says expected); they contribute zero volume to flow sums. Counted.
preprocessing.high_equals_low_bars: CLV undefined; excluded from both CMF numerator and denominator (never set to 0). Counted as locked/flat-range bars.

CMF20.formula: CLV_t = ((C-L)-(H-C))/(H-L) for H>L, else undefined; CMF20_T = sum_{valid t in last 20}(CLV_t*V_t) / sum_{valid t in last 20}(V_t)
unavailable_if: fewer than 20 sessions in segment up to T
any NaN in H/L/C/V inside window

NSV20.formula: (sum V_t on C_t>C_{t-1} - sum V_t on C_t<C_{t-1}) / sum V_t, over the last 20 sessions t (each needs C_{t-1} inside the same segment); flat close contributes 0 to numerator, its volume stays in denominator
unavailable_if: fewer than 21 closes in segment up to T
any NaN in C/V inside window

MFI14.role: RESEARCH ONLY (H6 redundancy test). Never part of PVFS.
MFI14.formula: TP=(H+L+C)/3; RMF=TP*V; positive flow if TP_t>TP_{t-1}, negative if TP_t<TP_{t-1}, equal -> neither; MFI=100*PF/(PF+NF) over last 14 sessions
unavailable_if: fewer than 15 sessions in segment up to T

RV20.formula: existing app.engines.technical.relative_volume.relative_volume_series(volume, 20) = V_T / rolling_median(V, 20); analysed as log(RV20)

median_turnover_20.role: RESEARCH ONLY: liquidity descriptor, not a signal
median_turnover_20.formula: median over 20 sessions of Close*Volume (TRY, APPROXIMATE because Close is dividend back-adjusted)
median_turnover_20.low_liquidity_definition: bottom cross-sectional quintile of median_turnover_20 on date T

ROC20_price.role: RESEARCH ONLY, used by H4/H5 conditions

PVFS.role: PRIMARY candidate composite. RESEARCH ONLY scales/weights, fixed ex ante, never calibrated in this study.
PVFS.formula: 100 * weighted mean of available components {c_cmf = clamp(CMF20/0.25, -1, 1), c_nsv = NSV20} with weights {0.5, 0.5}; follows the technical/scoring.py AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE contract (unavailable component removed from numerator and denominator)
PVFS.label: RESEARCH ONLY

not_added.AD_line: DO NOT ADD (duplicate of CMF information)
not_added.raw_OBV_level: DO NOT ADD (level meaningless; NSV20 is the normalized slope)
not_added.volume_momentum: DO NOT ADD (near-duplicate of existing relative volume)

technical_baseline.no_tuning_rule: Technical is never tuned, re-weighted or re-thresholded in this study.

targets.primary_return: INFORMATION target: Close(T) -> Close(T+h) where T+h is the h-th session after T in the same contiguous segment. Not necessarily a tradable price.
targets.primary_excess: stock return minus XU100 return over exactly the same two dates; XU100 must have valid bars on both dates.
targets.raw_return: reported as secondary context only for Flow quintiles
targets.execution_variant: SECONDARY, reported separately, never mixed: Open(E1) -> Close(E_h), E1 = first session after T, stock minus XU100 over the same E1..E_h dates.
targets.benchmark_processing: XU100 goes through the same completed-bar, calendar normalization and integrity steps; missing benchmark dates make the observation unavailable (never interpolated).
targets.dividend_note: Stock closes are dividend back-adjusted while XU100 is a price index; excess returns carry a dividend-yield offset. Cross-sectional rank statistics are largely unaffected.

horizons.override_rule: Secondary horizons never replace or override the T+10 primary conclusion.

cross_section_rules.quintile_assignment: per date, rank feature (average ties), pd.qcut of the rank into 5 equal-count bins

statistics.rank_ic: per eligible date: Pearson correlation of average-rank-transformed feature and average-rank-transformed forward excess return (= Spearman).
statistics.partial_ic_method: per eligible date: r_f = rank(feature), r_t = rank(technical_score) (and rank(RSI14) for H6); OLS r_f ~ 1 + controls; residual e; partial IC = Pearson(e, rank(forward excess return)). This is a rank semi-partial correlation: only the feature is residualized, so it measures information in the feature that is orthogonal to Technical. Technical's own relation to returns is never computed.
statistics.dates_not_independent: Stock-date rows are never treated as independent; inference is on the per-date statistic series.
statistics.uncertainty_primary: circular block bootstrap over the ordered series of eligible dates; block length 20 sessions (for the non-overlapping every-10th-date rebalance series: 2 steps = 20 sessions); 10000 replicates; seed 12001; two-sided 95% percentile CI (2.5, 97.5). Circular (wrap-around) instead of plain moving blocks because plain moving blocks under-sample series ends and produced a CI excluding the sample mean on a SYNTHETIC smoke run; changed before any real outcome was computed.
statistics.uncertainty_secondary: Newey-West HAC t-statistic of the mean (Bartlett kernel, lag = horizon h).
statistics.bootstrap_p_value: two-sided: 2*min(share of replicate means <= 0, share >= 0), floored at 1/B
statistics.multiple_testing: ONE primary hypothesis (P1). All other tests are secondary; Holm-adjusted p-values are reported across the full secondary family; no secondary result can establish the gate.

hypotheses.P1_primary: mean T+10 partial IC of PVFS controlling technical_score > 0. SUPPORTED iff bootstrap CI_low > 0; EVIDENCE_OPPOSITE_DIRECTION iff CI_high < 0; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED.
hypotheses.S_cmf_partial: mean partial IC of CMF20 controlling technical_score, all horizons
hypotheses.S_nsv_partial: mean partial IC of NSV20 controlling technical_score, all horizons
hypotheses.S_pvfs_partial_secondary_horizons: mean partial IC of PVFS at T+1, T+5, T+20
hypotheses.H1: Within Technical positive (score>=15) on date d: mean excess(T+10) of PVFS>=+20 group minus mean excess of the whole Technical-positive group, averaged over dates. SUPPORTED iff CI_low > 0.
hypotheses.H2: Within Technical positive: mean excess(T+10) of PVFS<=-20 group minus the whole Technical-positive group. SUPPORTED iff CI_high < 0.
hypotheses.H1_H2_spread: Within Technical positive: PVFS>=+20 group minus PVFS<=-20 group (descriptive).
hypotheses.flow_groups: positive: PVFS >= +20; neutral: -20 < PVFS < +20; negative: PVFS <= -20 (RESEARCH ONLY, fixed ex ante)
hypotheses.H4: Flat price |ROC20| <= 0.03 AND NSV20 >= +0.20 versus flat price AND NSV20 < +0.20; date-balanced delta of T+10 excess return. SUPPORTED iff CI_low > 0.
hypotheses.H5: Rising price ROC20 >= +0.10 AND NSV20 <= 0 versus rising price AND NSV20 > 0; date-balanced delta of T+10 excess return. SUPPORTED iff CI_high < 0.
hypotheses.H6: MFI14 is redundant: mean T+10 partial IC of MFI14 controlling rank(RSI14) and rank(technical_score). 'MFI adds information' iff CI_low > 0; otherwise MFI stays out of any future FlowScore.
hypotheses.hit_rate_deltas: For H1/H2/H4/H5 the same date-balanced delta is also reported for hit rate (share of excess return > 0), as percentage points.

portfolio_cost_sensitivity.applies_to: quintile long-short (Q5-Q1) and long-only Q5-minus-XU100 at T+10, for PVFS and for Technical-residualized PVFS
portfolio_cost_sensitivity.rebalance: non-overlapping: every 10th eligible date starting from the first eligible date
portfolio_cost_sensitivity.net_rule: net = gross - cost * turnover (each leg charged separately); no cost is subtracted from IC statistics

stability.by_calendar_year: mean T+10 partial IC (PVFS, CMF, NSV) per calendar year of T, with date counts
stability.by_market_regime: regime at T = sign of XU100 trailing 20-session return (up if > 0, else down); mean T+10 partial IC of PVFS per regime
stability.liquidity_robustness: P1 statistic recomputed excluding the bottom median_turnover_20 quintile (secondary)

correlations.primary_method: mean over dates of the cross-sectional Spearman correlation
correlations.secondary_method: pooled Spearman over all eligible observations

calibration.statement: No parameter is calibrated. All windows, scales, weights and thresholds are fixed research defaults declared here before any outcome is computed. Therefore no calibration/evaluation split is needed; stability is assessed by calendar year and regime.
calibration.no_post_hoc_rule: Primary horizon, PVFS definition, thresholds and gate rules may not change after results are seen. Any change creates FLOW_V1_OFFLINE_PROTOCOL_V2 and must be reported as such.

research_gate.DEVAM: P1 SUPPORTED AND the yearly T+10 PVFS partial-IC point estimate is positive in at least 2/3 of calendar years having >= 100 eligible dates AND the Technical-residualized PVFS Q5-Q1 net-of-20bps mean is > 0.
research_gate.DUR: P1 EVIDENCE_OPPOSITE_DIRECTION, OR P1 CI_high < min_meaningful_partial_ic (a meaningful positive effect can be excluded).
research_gate.BELIRSIZ: Every other case (e.g. CI contains 0 but also contains meaningful values, or P1 supported but year-stability or cost condition fails).
